{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Identify and count QA orders (revenue == '999999.99')
qa_orders = data[data['revenue'] == '999999.99']
num_qa_orders = len(qa_orders)
print(f"Number of QA orders: {num_qa_orders}")

# Drop QA orders
filtered_data = data[data['revenue'] != '999999.99']

# Drop refunded orders (keep only completed)
completed_orders = filtered_data[filtered_data['status'] == 'completed']
num_completed_orders = len(completed_orders)
print(f"Number of completed orders: {num_completed_orders}")

# Convert revenue to float: remove commas and cast
completed_orders['revenue_float'] = completed_orders['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = completed_orders['revenue_float'].mean()
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders: {mean_revenue}")

# Output the final values for submission
print(f"num_completed_orders: {num_completed_orders}")
print(f"mean_revenue: {mean_revenue}")"}
